findings.resolution: Both schema fields and archive path are reconciled to A102R40 and verified together.

findings.title: A58 still expected the A102R39 authority status and a 23-path executable denominator after A102R40 expanded the policy to 35 paths

findings.title: The first A102R40 SOURCE_ONLY archive was built before the final A58/current-state fixes

findings.title: The local regression receipt declared sourceImmutable without comparing the source payload before and after its 20 stages
findings.resolution: The regression builder now computes canonical current-source payloads before and after all stages and fails if any byte, path or canonical mode changes.

findings.title: The self-generated local regression receipt participated in its own approved-change diff lifecycle
findings.resolution: The local receipt is excluded from the approved-change ledger and is independently bound by the descendant manifest SHA and final package manifest.
